input.quote: 10.3 Assignment. This Agreement shall be binding upon, and shall inure to the benefit of and be enforceable by, the parties hereto and their respective legal representatives, successors and assigns, but no other person shall acquire or have any rights under this Agreement.
input.rationale: Section 10.3 is a bare successors-and-assigns provision with no consent standard, so HDI is free to assign the Agreement (including to a competitor of ours) without our consent. That fails even the fallback, which requires consent for non-successor assignments not to be unreasonably withheld. We therefore add one concise sentence pair at the preferred level: Company freedom to assign to an affiliate or to a merger, acquisition or substantially-all-assets successor, HDI assignment gated by our consent not unreasonably withheld and never to a Customer competitor, and no HDI termination right on our change of control. The existing sentence is left byte-for-byte intact.

ops.text: The Company may assign this Agreement without HDI's consent to an affiliate or to a successor in a merger, acquisition or sale of substantially all of its assets, and no change of control of the Company shall give HDI any right to terminate this Agreement. HDI may not assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Company (such consent not to be unreasonably withheld), and in no event to a competitor of the Company.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 10.3 is only a successors-and-assigns sentence, so HDI could assign this Agreement to anyone, including a competitor of ours, without our consent. We have added our freedom to assign to an affiliate or a merger/acquisition/asset-sale successor, HDI assignment subject to our consent not unreasonably withheld and never to a competitor, and confirmation that our change of control gives HDI no termination right.
proposal.summary: Insert assignment consent standard: Company free to assign to affiliates/successors, no HDI exit on our change of control, HDI assignment needs our consent and never to a competitor.
